description.zh:
SQL任务ID，可通过调用接口[GetDataExportOrderDetail](~~465911~~)获取JobId字段值。
如果字段值为Null，则说明未有导出任务生成。
description.en: The ID of the SQL result set export task. You can call the [GetDataExportOrderDetail](~~465911~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter. If you set this parameter to Null, no SQL result set export task is suspended.

description.zh: 工单ID，您可调用[ListOrders](~~144643~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the ticket. You can call the [ListOrders](~~144643~~) operation to obtain the ticket ID.

description.zh:
租户的ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the tenant.

> To view the ID of the tenant, go to the DMS console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~) section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic.
